public_note: The 48 items are virtual-reality trials in which a 3D car approaches the participant, so no item wording exists and item_text is blank by design; the item code carries the stimulus, in the form @<front-surface-area-in-pixels>_<car>_<actual-speed-in-km/h>_<viewing-position>, where insel = standing on the pedestrian centre island and trottoir = standing on the pavement, and the eight cars are Nissan Micra K12 (nis), Kia Picanto BA (kia), Mercedes SLK R171 (merc), Chrysler Crossfire (chr), VW New Beetle 9C (vw), Toyota Prius II NHW20 (toy), BMW 6 series E63 (bmw) and Alfa Romeo 147 (alf). resp is not the raw estimate but the signed estimation error in km/h (verbal estimate minus the car's actual speed), so 0 is a veridical judgement and the raw estimate is resp plus the speed token in the item code
